主要内容: The document titled '6-K' is a report filed by the Royal Bank of Canada with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) on March 9, 2016. It is a Form 6-K filing, which is used by foreign private issuers to report information to the SEC. The filing includes a notice of the Annual and Special Meeting of Common Shareholders and Management Proxy Circular dated February 8, 2016, as well as a form of proxy mailed to common shareholders on March 9, 2016. The report is signed by Karen E. McCarthy, who holds the title of Vice-President, Associate General Counsel & Secretary. This filing is part of the bank's regulatory reporting obligations and provides information about shareholder meetings and proxy processes.
